nodes.title: SG-5.2 · Inventory and interaction through the runner
nodes.body:
Context: game/src/systems/runner.ts (runStep) already runs object actions and dialogue choices over scene content, and inventory.ts and interaction.ts are used by events.ts and the entities. The frontend still bypasses the runner. useGame.act calls performAction in engine/scene.ts and useGame.choose calls chooseOption in systems/dialogue.ts. SceneObject.ts keeps its own copy of availableActions. Desired behavior: every action and choice in the running game goes through runStep and the Zustand store, and the old direct paths are removed. Expected result: the boys-room plays the same. Why: SG-5 requires one content-driven runner.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the boys-room is running, when an object action or a dialogue choice is applied, then useGame calls runStep and writes the result through useGameStore.setState
- Given the codebase after the change, when searching game/src and game/frontend/src, then performAction and chooseOption no longer exist
- Given the change, when npm test and npm run typecheck run in game/ and game/frontend/, then both pass with no test deleted or skipped


## Scope
- In scope: useGame routed through runStep
- In scope: App transition emitted from runner events
- In scope: SceneObject uses interaction.ts availableActions
- In scope: delete performAction and chooseOption and rewrite their tests against runStep
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: frontend/src/api/client.ts
- Out of scope: new features, content or art
- Out of scope: SG-5.1 runner internals
- Preserve: boys-room gameplay, story panel, inventory, transitions, save and reload
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin and its guard test


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- The Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- No test is deleted or skipped; tests that pinned internals are rewritten against behaviour
- Tests mock only what is external
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope


## Definition of done
- Requirements REQ1 to REQ3 are done and verified
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · useGame applies actions and choices through runStep and the store
nodes.body:
Context: frontend/src/runtime/useGame.ts imports performAction and chooseOption and applies them inside useGameStore.setState. Desired behavior: both call runStep({ scene }, prev, input) inside setState, and act returns the GameEvent[] that the runner emitted. Expected result: items are picked up and used and dialogue advances exactly as before. Why: the frontend interaction path must use the runner.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a bookshelf search action, when useGame.act runs, then the store state equals runStep applied to the previous state and the emitted events are returned
- Given an active dialogue node, when useGame.choose(i) runs, then the store state equals runStep with a choose input
- Given an action whose conditions fail, when useGame.act runs, then the state is unchanged and the returned events are []


## Scope
- In scope: frontend/src/runtime/useGame.ts
- Out of scope: runner.ts logic changes
- Preserve: save after every state change via the store
- Preserve: UseGame field names state, scene, view, choose


## Technical constraints
- Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- File stays under 200 lines


## Dependencies
- game/src/systems/runner.ts runStep


## Definition of done
- useGame has no import of performAction or chooseOption
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend/


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · The old direct action and choice logic is deleted and its tests rewritten
nodes.body:
Context: performAction (src/engine/scene.ts) and chooseOption (src/systems/dialogue.ts) duplicate runStep. tests/systems.test.ts, tests/persistence.test.ts and tests/content.test.ts call them. Desired behavior: both functions and their now-unused imports are deleted; the tests that used them are rewritten to call runStep with the same scenarios and assertions. Expected result: one code path for action and choice. Why: the old direct paths must be removed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo, when grepping game/src and game/frontend/src for performAction and chooseOption, then there are no matches
- Given the rewritten tests, when they run, then they assert the same state results (flags, inventory, scene change, unchanged state on failed condition) using runStep
- Given getSceneView and getActiveNode, when they are used, then they still work unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/engine/scene.ts
- In scope: game/src/systems/dialogue.ts
- Out of scope: getSceneView behaviour
- Out of scope: getActiveNode behaviour
- Preserve: getSceneView and getActiveNode exports


## Technical constraints
- No test is deleted or skipped
- Tests mock only what is external
- Files stay under 200 lines


## Dependencies
- REQ1 so that nothing in the frontend imports the old functions


## Definition of done
- Both functions are deleted and no import of them remains


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Interaction path uses runner events and the shared interaction helper
nodes.body:
Context: App.handleAction compares currentScene before and after game.act to decide on transitionTo. SceneObject.ts defines its own availableActions identical to systems/interaction.ts. Desired behavior: App emits transitionTo for a goto_scene event returned by game.act, and SceneObject imports availableActions from systems/interaction. Expected result: the same transitions and the same action lists, with no duplicate helper. Why: interaction is driven by the runner and content data.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an action whose events include goto_scene, when App handles it, then reactToPhaser emits transitionTo with that scene id and playAnimation interact
- Given an action with no goto_scene event, when App handles it, then transitionTo is not emitted but playAnimation interact is
- Given SceneObject.ts, when read, then it defines no local availableActions


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/App.tsx handleAction
- In scope: game/src/entities/SceneObject.ts
- Out of scope: Phaser scene code
- Out of scope: StoryPanel layout
- Preserve: interact animation on every action
- Preserve: the keyboard activation and hover behaviour of SceneObject


## Technical constraints
- Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Files stay under 200 lines


## Dependencies
- REQ1 act returns events


## Definition of done
- No scene comparison before/after in App.handleAction
- One availableActions definition


## Clarifying questions
- None
